name: Tavern
description: Residents at the tavern: sitting, eating, drinking, toasting, talking across the table, listening to the bard, leaning on the bar.

clips.name: Leans back with hands behind the head
Cranes over the shoulder for the keeper
Taps a spoon on the table
Swirls the drink and peers in
Spoons up stew and blows on it
Tears the bread and takes a bite
Savors a bite with eyes closed
Pats a full belly and leans back
Tells a story with both hands
Tells a story waving the mug
Leans back skeptical with arms folded
Belly laughs and slaps the table
Bows from the seat with a hand on the heart
Leans an elbow on the counter
Raises a toast at the bar
Sways to the music at the bar
Rings the bell for last orders
